title: fln configuration
description: Configuration file for fln — flatten your codebase into a single file for LLMs

output.description: Output file path or directory. Default: auto-generated from project metadata (e.g. my-app-1.0.0.md)

overwrite.description: Overwrite output file instead of adding numeric suffix when it already exists

exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude. Prefix with ! to un-ignore after .gitignore (e.g. ["*.log", "!important.log"]). CLI: --exclude

include.description: Force-include paths (additive; bypasses ignore and hidden dotfiles). CLI: --include

only.description: Whitelist: only matching files are scanned. CLI: --only, --since, --ext

onlyMode.description: When true with only, scan is restricted to the whitelist. Default: true when only is set via CLI/API

relevant.description: Relevant mode: only include files transitively imported by seed paths. Parses imports from file headers (first 8KB). Supports TS/JS, Python, Go, Rust, Java, C/C++.

includeHidden.description: Include hidden files and directories (starting with .)

maxTotalSize.description: Maximum output file size. Graceful omit by default; use strictLimits to throw. Atomic write — no partial file on disk

maxTokens.description: Maximum estimated tokens in output (0 = unlimited). Lower-priority files omitted first. CLI: --max-tokens

maxContentTokens.description: Token budget for source file sections only (0 = use maxTokens for entire output)

strictLimits.description: Throw when maxTotalSize or maxTokens would be exceeded

compress.description: Extract signatures (imports, types, function signatures) — bodies omitted. Falls back to full content for unsupported file types.

outline.description: Outline mode — signatures only for every file; unsupported files get a placeholder. Implies contents.

diffHunks.description: With since: embed unified git diff hunks instead of full files

strictToctou.description: Throw when a file changed between scan and render (TOCTOU) instead of warning

annotateTree.description: Annotate directory tree with per-file token, line, or byte-size counts. tokens/lines defer tree to end of output (single-pass). CLI: --annotate-tree

collectTodo.description: Collect TODO/FIXME/HACK/XXX/NOTE/BUG/WARN markers into a separate section (render-phase). CLI: --collect-todo

since.description: Git ref for diffHunks mode (usually set via CLI --since)

securityPatterns.description: Additional glob patterns for sensitive paths to skip

securityCheck.description: Security scan depth: default (512-byte header) or strict (4KB header, expanded patterns, lower entropy threshold)

outputSplit.description: Maximum output parts when split by limits

contents.description: Include file contents in output. CLI: --no-contents to exclude (tree only)

tree.description: Include directory tree in output. CLI: --no-tree to exclude

followSymlinks.description: Follow symlinks while scanning; in-root-only warns on escape

ansi.description: Use ANSI colors in log output

date.description: Fixed date string for the Generated header (overrides current date). Format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm

banner.description: Custom text prepended to output after the header

bannerFile.description: Path to file whose contents are prepended to output (relative to input directory). File is excluded from tree

footer.description: Custom text appended to the end of output

footerFile.description: Path to file whose contents are appended to output (relative to input directory). File is excluded from tree
